$comment: Life areas (report part V). Career and family are read from the Bhagyank, money, love and health from the Mulank. The child field is the parents' wording. Draft text by Claude, for numerologist review.

life.career.1.text: Career: leadership, entrepreneurship and roles with authority. Aim for positions where you decide.
life.career.1.child: Learning: give responsibility and choice; leadership activities build confidence.

life.career.2.text: Career: partnership, care, mediation and the arts. Choose teams that value harmony.
life.career.2.child: Learning: a gentle, encouraging setting and group work suit best.

life.career.3.text: Career: teaching, advice, law and finance. Expertise and reputation are your capital.
life.career.3.child: Learning: reading, discussion and explaining ideas to others build strength.

life.career.4.text: Career: technology, engineering, research and systems. Careful, practical work brings advancement.
life.career.4.child: Learning: hands-on projects, science and maths with clear steps suit best.

life.career.5.text: Career: business, sales, media and travel. Variety and people keep you at your best.
life.career.5.child: Learning: short, varied sessions and languages or debate keep interest high.

life.career.6.text: Career: design, healthcare, hospitality and teaching. A pleasant workplace matters.
life.career.6.child: Learning: art, music and caring roles bring out talent.

life.career.7.text: Career: research, analysis, healing and specialist fields. Depth and independence suit you.
life.career.7.child: Learning: time to explore one subject deeply, with quiet space.

life.career.8.text: Career: business leadership, finance, property and industry. Patience builds lasting authority.
life.career.8.child: Learning: clear goals, routines and steady encouragement.

life.career.9.text: Career: service, the armed forces, medicine, sport and causes. Purpose fuels your energy.
life.career.9.child: Learning: physical activity first, then focused study; competitions motivate.

life.money.1.text: Money: earned through position and initiative. Invest in your own skills and ventures.
life.money.1.child: Money habits: trust them with a small allowance to manage.

life.money.2.text: Money: steady income and partnership bring security. Keep a simple budget.
life.money.2.child: Money habits: a visible savings jar builds security.

life.money.3.text: Money: grows through expertise and long-term plans. Avoid lending too freely.
life.money.3.child: Money habits: saving toward books or courses suits them.

life.money.4.text: Money: earned by hard work; keep a reserve for the unexpected.
life.money.4.child: Money habits: a simple record of saving and spending.

life.money.5.text: Money: comes fast through trade and contacts, and can go fast. Automate savings.
life.money.5.child: Money habits: wait a day before buying something new.

life.money.6.text: Money: steady, with spending on home and loved ones. Plan for comfort.
life.money.6.child: Money habits: plan for gifts and save for one wanted thing.

life.money.7.text: Money: can be uneven; a steady savings habit protects you.
life.money.7.child: Money habits: explain the purpose of saving to them.

life.money.8.text: Money: builds slowly and solidly, especially through property and patience.
life.money.8.child: Money habits: long-term goals with small celebrations along the way.

life.money.9.text: Money: comes through effort; generosity is good, but set aside savings first.
life.money.9.child: Money habits: set aside a part of any money before spending.

life.love.1.text: Love: loyal and protective; a partner who respects your independence suits you.
life.love.1.child: Friendships: a natural leader among friends; teach sharing and turn-taking.

life.love.2.text: Love: devoted and caring; you need warmth and appreciation in return.
life.love.2.child: Friendships: close, loyal friendships; help them speak up for themselves.

life.love.3.text: Love: generous and principled; shared values matter most.
life.love.3.child: Friendships: often the advisor among friends.

life.love.4.text: Love: slow to open up but faithful; trust grows over time.
life.love.4.child: Friendships: a few lasting friends; encourage sharing feelings.

life.love.5.text: Love: charming and fun; freedom and conversation keep love alive.
life.love.5.child: Friendships: many friends; help them stay loyal to close ones.

life.love.6.text: Love: deeply loving and family-centred; care without controlling.
life.love.6.child: Friendships: caring and generous; teach them to receive as well as give.

life.love.7.text: Love: deep but reserved; a partner who respects quiet suits you.
life.love.7.child: Friendships: one or two close friends; respect their need for quiet.

life.love.8.text: Love: shown through duty and loyalty; say the warm words too.
life.love.8.child: Friendships: dependable; encourage play and lightness.

life.love.9.text: Love: passionate and generous; patience keeps it smooth.
life.love.9.child: Friendships: protective of friends; teach calm ways to resolve quarrels.

blocks.life.family.1: Family: often the one who takes charge and protects the family's standing.
blocks.life.family.2: Family: the peacemaker who keeps everyone connected.
blocks.life.family.3: Family: the guide whose advice is sought and respected.
blocks.life.family.4: Family: the steady provider who keeps things running.
blocks.life.family.5: Family: the lively one who brings news, fun and change.
blocks.life.family.6: Family: the heart of the home, caring for everyone.
blocks.life.family.7: Family: the quiet thinker who offers deep counsel.
blocks.life.family.8: Family: the pillar who carries responsibility for many.
blocks.life.family.9: Family: the protector who stands up for family members.
blocks.life.health.1: Health tendencies: watch for overwork; regular rest and sunlight help.
blocks.life.health.2: Health tendencies: stress shows in digestion and sleep; calm routines help.
blocks.life.health.3: Health tendencies: moderation in rich food and regular walks help.
blocks.life.health.4: Health tendencies: nervous tension; fixed routines and fresh air help.
blocks.life.health.5: Health tendencies: restlessness; regular meals and breathing exercises help.
blocks.life.health.6: Health tendencies: watch sweets and comfort habits; gentle exercise helps.
blocks.life.health.7: Health tendencies: worry and irregular habits; meditation and nature walks help.
blocks.life.health.8: Health tendencies: joints and bones; stretching and rest days help.
blocks.life.health.9: Health tendencies: haste and over-exertion; warm-ups and calm help.
